metadata.name: GoodTripPlus
metadata.description:
Minimap teleport mod based on Goodtrip MLX's Tweak. Hold TAB to activate a cursor on the minimap, use the shoot direction keys to select a room, and release TAB to teleport. Supports the mirrored map in the mirror world. Curse room teleportation is disabled by default. Default cursor speed is 2.
GoodTripPlus additionally fixes a bug where every pickup icon on the minimap vanished after using the "rewind" console command, and only came back after re-entering each room one by one.
It also bundles the Secret Room candidate markers from Lazy Delver (by dokee, MIT), re-projected onto GoodTripPlus' own map math so they line up with MinimapAPI exactly. Please disable Lazy Delver itself to avoid drawing two sets of markers.
Optional (MCM: AllowUnexploredNeighbor, off by default): teleport into a room you have never entered, as long as it sits next to an explored room reachable from your current room.
New (MCM: FoolsSkullRoom, on by default): marks the room in Depths II that holds the special skull which always drops The Fool card, with a custom skull icon. The icon only appears on rooms you have already visited, so it never spoils the floor layout.
Default settings can be changed in the MCM menu or config file. Please uninstall or disable goodtrip_mlxtweak (and the original Goodtrip) before use. Required: MinimapAPI
Optional: Mod Config Menu (for in-game settings)
Credits: original GoodTrip by tarako; this build is based on Goodtrip MLX's Tweak; Secret Room candidate markers are ported from Lazy Delver by dokee (MIT). See LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md for details.
